findings.fixHint: Add a stable `data-composition-id` to the entry composition wrapper.
Set numeric `data-width` and `data-height` on the entry composition root.

findings.message: <audio id="vo-scene1"> has data-start="4.5" inside a sub-composition. Nested media timing is local to its composition by default; a nonzero value can be confused with a legacy root-global timestamp.
findings.fixHint: Keep data-start="4.5" if it is composition-local. If this is a legacy root-global timestamp, add data-hf-media-start-basis="global"; otherwise convert it to local time by subtracting the host start.

findings.message: <div class="counter-desk" data-start="0"> has no id, so Studio cannot use a stable edit target for its timeline and canvas controls.
findings.fixHint: Add a stable, human-readable id such as id="hero-title" or id="scene-1-card" to every timeline-visible element you want agents or Studio to edit.
